hookups.source: https://www.molaslake.com/DOCS_2024/MOLASLAKE_sitedescr_12152024_for2025_all_2026.pdf ('There are no on-site water or electricity hookups available'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: The home page says 62 campsites (the FAQ says 58). The 2026 site sheet describes 4 Lake-View Ultra RV and 8 Rock Cliff Standard RV sites (50-57, all back-in) that take RVs of any size, 29 Small RV/Tent and 15 Premium Water View sites mostly limited to motorhomes up to 23 ft or trailers up to 20 ft, some 14-15 ft and some tent-only. Site 2 is a pull-through for RVs up to 23 ft.

sites.source: https://www.molaslake.com/ ('The Campground has 62 campsites') + https://www.molaslake.com/DOCS_2024/MOLASLAKE_sitedescr_12152024_for2025_all_2026.pdf (site categories and individual descriptions), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Hot showers by $5 token, not guaranteed after September 15. A water pump by the office; RVs may take up to 30 gallons. Nearest dump station in Silverton, 10 minutes away. No internet and limited cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.molaslake.com/faqs.html ('vault-style toilets without electricity or running water. A central water pump provides clean, potable water'; showers $5 per token; 'no longer has a dump station'; Molas Lake Store) + https://www.molaslake.com/DOCS_2024/MOLASLAKE_sitedescr_12152024_for2025_all_2026.pdf ('RVs can fill up to 30 gallons'; 'There is no internet connectivity'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.molaslake.com/ ('CAMPING SEASON IS JUNE 1-SEPT 30') + https://www.molaslake.com/campingreservations.html ('The campground is open from June 1st to September 30th'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Online through the Town of Silverton's WebReserv calendar, by site number within a site type; the season's reservations open January 1. Sells out most of the summer. Cancel within 90 days of booking and 7+ days before arrival for a 50% refund; otherwise no refund. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.molaslake.com/campingreservations.html ('Reservations for the season open on January 1st'; WebReserv booking calendar) + https://www.molaslake.com/DOCS_2024/MOLASLAKE_RESERVATION_POLICIES_05262024_2026.pdf (cancellation policy) + https://www.molaslake.com/faqs.html ('we do sell out for most of the summer'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Small RV/Tent and Rock Cliff Standard RV sites $50, Premium Water View $70, Lake-View Ultra RV $90 a night, plus 10.4% tax. Rates rise 50% over the July 4th and Labor Day holiday periods ($75 / $105 / $135).

fees.source: https://www.molaslake.com/DOCS_2024/MOLASLAKE_sitedescr_12152024_for2025_all_2026.pdf ('Price is $50/night, plus 10.4% tax' Small RV/Tent and Rock Cliff Standard RV; $70 Premium Water View; $90 Lake-View Ultra RV; holiday +50%), read 2026-10-27

note: Town-of-Silverton-run high-alpine park at ~10,508 ft on US-550 (Million Dollar Hwy) at a stocked 25-acre lake. Generators only in the Ultra RV and Rock Cliff RV sites, 8 AM-8 PM; no swimming. --Claude
summary: Operator site, FAQ and 2026 site/rate sheet: confirmed no hookups, 62 sites, showers ($5), store, water fill, no dump, June 1-Sept 30, reservable. Added vault toilets, no flush/wifi, season dates, WebReserv link, $50-90 fees, site-size note. Note: dropped the site count, hookups, amenities, season and booking restatements.
flags: Waterfront lead (stored lakeview): the Premium Water View sites are the lakefront row (P30-P44, 'closest sites to the lake', several 'directly on the water' / 'fish directly from camp'), and P32, P33/P34, P35 and P44 take RVs up to 23 ft - so a 23-ft motorhome can camp lakefront here. P32 is described as 'This waterfront site on the North end of the lake ... suitable for RVs up to 23 ft'. Possible lakeview -> lakefront upgrade; needs the waterfront gate (satellite).

Fit: EKKO (23 ft) is at the limit of the Small RV/Tent and Premium Water View sites ('generally motorhomes under 23 ft', some sites 'up to 23 ft'); the 4 Ultra RV and 8 Rock Cliff RV sites take any size.
Phone: none stored. The camping page gives the campground host's line 970-880-2982 (for payment help); the operator says email (info@molaslake.com) is the best contact. Suggest adding 970-880-2982.
Site count: home page 62, FAQ 58; the rate sheet describes about 56 named sites. Kept 62 (the home page).
Pin matches the operator's published coordinates (37°44'50.80", 107°40'59.56"); seasonal, closed now until June 1, 2027.
